description:
#Learn the history and culture of Key West!

## Duration
2 Hours


## About
Join us for the best walking tour in Key West! 

You will be amazed by how much history and culture our small island has! Local Guide will take you on a time travel adventure. As you stroll through the scenic streets of the Old Town, you will learn how the island was discovered and became one of the richest cities in the USA!

Hear the stories of the first industries on the island, such as shipwrecking, sponge harvesting and cigarmaking. Also, learn what key role Key West played in the Cuban fight for its independence and find out why Key West declared the war against the United States. 

The private tour is the best way to explore Key West and have fun with your own group of friends or family!

Book Now and call us to schedule the time that is convenient for you! 

*The tour takes place rain or shine - Ponchos will be provided if necessary.*


## Walking Distance 
Please plan to walk approximately 1.4 to 1.8 miles during the tour. 


## What to Bring
- Hat, sunglasses, and sunblock are a must.
- Bring at least one bottle of water for yourself. We will walk and it gets
hot! 
- Wear comfortable clothing and shoes. Sneakers are the best option.
- Tour guide gratuity is not included in your ticket. If you had a great
time, please tip your guide! It is standard in the service industry to tip
10-20% of the ticket price.
- Camera or your phone to take pictures.
- Your adventurous spirit!
